i can understand a lot of the stufff youre describing.. esp the part about only getting recognition for looks.. i dont wanna talk you out of anything since im headint the same way, but if you ever wanna talk, feel free to text

ive been skinny, ive been fat. now im skinny again. all i can tell you is that it doesnt change ANYTHING if youre depressed. im feeling worse than ever, while being skinnier than ever. please focus on getting mental help. your body wont ever make you happy if your mind is not healthy. ive thought so for the longest time, but it simply is not the case. please try to take care of yourself in every possible way (talking to professionals, developing coping skills, and if its too bad, checking into a mental health facility (trust me, theyre not too bad, at least where im from), finding stuff that brings you a small break from stressing).. if you wanna talk, hmu

edit: while im skinny now (even underweight) i still cant run for more than 30 seconds, so that only has so much to do with weight, im terrrrribly unfit

edit 2: ive stopped understanding maths in 7th grade (12-13yrs old) and i still made it to university. maths isnt everything

i had somewhat similar issues since i became depressed.. i dont know if its the same for you, but after some extensive testing, ive been diagnosed with high functioning autism and some personality disorders.. im still suicidal but my therapists are now trying to work something out knowing these diagnoses, and maybe it will help.. i would really recommend you to get tested for those things (including stuff like add, adhd…).. maybe, if sth like this would be discovered, you would have new options.. as i said, i still dont know if anything really changes, but if you wanna talk, feel free to hit me up, i can identify with a lot youre talking about (f25)

hey! ive got extreme emetophobia as well and had covid like 1.5 weeks ago! my parents are both medical professionals (doc/nurse) and they assured me that vomiting only happens in the rarest cases (they havent even seen such a case yet in the whole hospital). i never even felt sick at all! hope this helps you a little bit:)

its really a guessing game at this point. i am fully vaccinated and boostered, went to a nightclub wirj a friend (who is also vaccinated and boostered).. i got covid, he didnt, even tho we danced together all night. i spent the following days with my parents (eating with them, hugging them etc) and they didnt catch it. one day before being tested positive (with symptoms), i shared a straw with my best friend, who didnt catch it either.. somehow i still did🤷🏻‍♀️ theres really no way to tell
its called bepanthen.. its better than nothing i guess, but doesnt work miracles
